Use case: stylized-concept. Source sheet of original hand-painted fantasy game equipment sprites for RagRPG. Image 1 establishes format, detailed organic material painting and style; Image 2 shows book and staff treatments and gives the ivory prayer book design; Image 3 shows one-object-per-column spacing and clean silhouettes. Use the references for style but draw ONLY the eight new specified objects below.

Native ultrawide 3:1 landscape PNG around 2172 × 724 with genuine clear alpha. Exactly one horizontal row of exactly EIGHT objects, one per equal-width column. Each object is independent, separated by a wide fully clear vertical gutter from all neighbors, and kept within generous outer margins. Allow an item to be narrower or shorter to fit comfortably in its own column, especially frontal shields, book with chain, bows with string and leafy branches. Center objects vertically in this sole row. Show each complete object upright as used, handles of hand-held weapons at bottom, and shields from the front. No contact or overlap between objects. Match painted metal, wood and leather textures, fine organic outlines and neutral upper-left highlights. Strong silhouettes readable near 80 × 130 pixels.

Left to right in exact order:
1. a single straight dark steel ritual dagger, black leather grip at bottom, one short hinged iron chain attached to the pommel.
2. a single upright closed blue crystalline cover tome wound tightly in iron chain with one iron padlock.
3. a single upright darkened bronze khopesh short hook sword, unmistakable bronze curved sickle blade, faded cloth ties attached by the lower handle.
4. a single small front-facing round polished steel buckler with simple dark rim and central steel boss.
5. a single front-facing polished steel shield with an engraved gold ring around a small, restrained multicolored stained-glass insert exactly in the center.
6. a single front-facing gray stone shield, thick gray plates physically bound by living roots and moss.
7. a single upright ivory acolyte prayer book using the split gold sun / dark plum moon medallion from the left hand book in Image 2, with a long iron flail chain extending upward from the cover in a narrow path within this column.
8. a single upright ivory acolyte prayer book with the same split sun and moon front cover, with a thin pointed blade emerging from the book's spine and attached directly to it.

Do not add any other equipment, loose objects, hands, bodies, shadows, ground, glow, particles, letters, captions, dividers, grid lines or framing. Empty space is genuinely transparent with no backdrop, stray marks or haze.
